no_qa_reason: Telling these notifications apart needs a real Claude Code session that sends a plugin or agent-view notice, which cannot be triggered on demand; covered by Rust tests through the real HTTP hook.
title: Parking: notifications that need nobody no longer bring a parked terminal back
seam: classify_notification and its tests in src-tauri/src/core/status_server.rs
story: Before this change, a plugin message or a background agent notice could pull a parked terminal back into the grid with nothing for you to do. Now those notices leave the terminal parked and its status unchanged. A usage-limit pause you must resume by hand still brings it back, and so does any notice type Maestro does not know yet.
